        throw std::invalid_argument("STREAM3_BATCH_CANDIDATES must be divisible by B_MICRO * MOVE_COUNT");
    }
    derived.ring_slot_count = config.stream3_batch_candidates / candidates_per_slot;
    derived.beam_width_alignment =
        static_cast<std::uint64_t>(config.world_size) *

    derived.global_beam_width_effective = round_up(config.user_global_beam_width, derived.beam_width_alignment);
    return derived;
}

std::uint32_t q_to_score_key(float q) {
    const float clamped = std::min(std::max(q, 0.0f), SCORE_MAX_Q);
    return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::lround(clamped * static_cast<float>(SCORE_SCALE)));
}

StaticMemoryPlan make_static_memory_plan(const RuntimeConfig& config) {
    const DerivedConfig derived = derive_config(config);
    if (config.b_micro == 0 || config.ring_count == 0 || derived.ring_slot_count == 0 ||
        config.world_size == 0 || config.shard_count == 0 || config.stream4_active_sort_slots == 0 ||
        config.shard_capacity_candidates == 0 || derived.global_beam_width_effective == 0) {
        throw std::invalid_argument("static memory config contains zero-sized architecture dimension");
    }
    StaticMemoryPlan plan;
    plan.config = config;
    plan.derived = derived;
    plan.frontier_states =
        (derived.global_beam_width_effective + static_cast<std::uint64_t>(config.world_size) - 1ULL) /
        static_cast<std::uint64_t>(config.world_size);
    if (plan.frontier_states > static_cast<std::uint64_t>(std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max())) {
        throw std::invalid_argument("local frontier capacity exceeds uint32 final target index range");
    }
    plan.score_ring_count =
        static_cast<std::uint64_t>(config.ring_count) * derived.ring_slot_count * config.b_micro * MOVE_COUNT;
    plan.hash_ring_count = plan.score_ring_count;
    plan.parent_base_count = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(config.ring_count) * derived.ring_slot_count;
    plan.ring_count_count = plan.parent_base_count;
    plan.stream3_count = config.stream3_batch_candidates;
    plan.stream5_slot_count = config.world_size > 1U ? config.ring_count : 1U;
    plan.stream5_send_slot_capacity = plan.stream3_count;
    plan.stream5_recv_slot_capacity = std::max<std::uint64_t>(
        plan.stream3_count,
        (plan.stream3_count * static_cast<std::uint64_t>(config.stream5_recv_capacity_scale_ppm) + 999'999ULL) /
            1'000'000ULL);
    plan.final_materialize_slot_count = FINAL_MATERIALIZE_SLOT_COUNT;
    plan.final_materialize_chunk_capacity =
        std::max<std::uint64_t>(1ULL, std::min<std::uint64_t>(plan.frontier_states, plan.stream3_count));
    plan.final_materialize_exchange_capacity =
        plan.final_materialize_chunk_capacity * static_cast<std::uint64_t>(config.world_size);
    plan.final_selected_candidate_capacity =
        (plan.frontier_states * sizeof(State128)) / sizeof(CandidateMeta);
    plan.storage_shard_count = storage_shard_count_for(config);
    plan.survivor_count =
        static_cast<std::uint64_t>(plan.storage_shard_count) * config.shard_capacity_candidates;
    plan.final_state_count = plan.frontier_states;
    const std::uint32_t stream3_partition_count = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(
        std::max<std::uint64_t>(plan.stream3_count, config.global_spill_capacity));
    plan.stream3_cub_temp_bytes = std::max(
        stream3_cub_temp_bytes(config.stream3_batch_candidates),
        stream3_partition_cub_temp_bytes(stream3_partition_count, config.shard_count));
    plan.stream4_cub_temp_bytes = stream4_cub_temp_bytes(config.shard_capacity_candidates);
    plan.final_materialize_cub_temp_bytes = final_materialize_cub_temp_bytes(
        static_cast<std::uint32_t>(plan.final_materialize_exchange_capacity));
    plan.current_frontier_bytes = static_cast<std::size_t>(plan.frontier_states) * sizeof(State128);

void allocate_static_device_memory(const StaticMemoryPlan& plan, StaticDeviceMemory& memory) {
    if (memory.allocation != nullptr) {
        throw std::invalid_argument("static device memory must be freed before reallocation");
    }

    if (err != cudaSuccess) {

__global__ void final_scatter_load_balance_kernel(
    const CandidateMeta* survivor_shard,
    const std::uint32_t* keep_flags,
    const std::uint32_t* block_offsets,
    const std::uint32_t* output_base,
    CandidateMeta* final_candidate_buffer,
    std::uint32_t* final_candidate_count,
    FinalRequest* final_request_buffer,
    std::uint32_t local_rank,
    std::uint32_t world_size,
    std::uint64_t global_prefix_for_rank,
    std::uint64_t global_keep_count,
    std::uint32_t final_capacity,
    std::uint32_t shard_count,
    std::uint32_t shard_capacity_candidates,
    std::uint32_t stream4_batch_candidates) {
    __shared__ std::uint32_t scan[256];
    const std::uint32_t tid = threadIdx.x;
    const std::uint64_t shard_capacity = shard_capacity_candidates;
    const std::uint64_t total = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(shard_count) * shard_capacity;
    const std::uint64_t i = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + tid;
    const std::uint32_t keep = i < total ? keep_flags[i] : 0U;
    scan[tid] = keep;
    __syncthreads();
    for (std::uint32_t offset = 1U; offset < blockDim.x; offset <<= 1U) {
        const std::uint32_t add = tid >= offset ? scan[tid - offset] : 0U;
        __syncthreads();
        scan[tid] += add;
        __syncthreads();
    }
    const std::uint64_t balance_keep_count =
        world_size == 1U ? static_cast<std::uint64_t>(*final_candidate_count) : global_keep_count;
    if (keep == 0U || *final_candidate_count > final_capacity || balance_keep_count == 0ULL || world_size == 0U) {
        return;
    }
    const std::uint32_t local_out = final_phase_base_device(output_base) + block_offsets[blockIdx.x] + scan[tid] - 1U;
    if (local_out >= *final_candidate_count) {
        return;
    }
    const std::uint64_t global_idx = global_prefix_for_rank + local_out;
    std::uint32_t target_rank = static_cast<std::uint32_t>((global_idx * world_size) / balance_keep_count);
    if (target_rank >= world_size) {
        target_rank = world_size - 1U;
    }
    const std::uint64_t target_rank_begin =
        ceil_div_u64_device(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(target_rank) * balance_keep_count, world_size);
    const std::uint32_t target_local_idx = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(global_idx - target_rank_begin);
    const CandidateMeta candidate = survivor_shard[i];
    final_candidate_buffer[local_out] = candidate;
    if (target_rank == local_rank) {
        FinalRequest request{};
        request.parent_idx = candidate.parent_idx;
        request.target_local_idx = target_local_idx;
        request.return_rank = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(target_rank);
        request.move = unpack_move_threshold_device(candidate.route_packed);
        final_request_buffer[target_local_idx] = request;
    }
}

void stream5_exchange_u64_payload_nccl_cuda(
    const void* send_buffer,
    void* recv_buffer,
    const std::uint32_t* host_send_count,
    const std::uint32_t* host_send_offset,
    const std::uint32_t* host_recv_count,

    std::uint32_t world_size,
    ncclComm_t comm,
    cudaStream_t stream) {
    NvtxRange range("Stream5_NCCL_u64_payload_exchange_launch");
    if (world_size == 0 || local_rank >= world_size || words_per_item == 0U) {
        throw std::invalid_argument("stream5 generic NCCL payload exchange parameters are invalid");
    }

    const auto* send_words = reinterpret_cast<const std::uint64_t*>(send_buffer);
    auto* recv_words = reinterpret_cast<std::uint64_t*>(recv_buffer);
    check_nccl(ncclGroupStart(), "ncclGroupStart generic payload exchange");
    for (std::uint32_t peer = 0; peer < world_size; ++peer) {
        if (peer == local_rank) {
            continue;
        }
        check_nccl(ncclSend(
                       send_words + static_cast<std::uint64_t>(host_send_offset[peer]) * words_per_item,
                       static_cast<std::size_t>(host_send_count[peer]) * words_per_item,
                       ncclUint64,
                       static_cast<int>(peer),
                       comm,
                       stream),
                   "ncclSend generic payload");
        check_nccl(ncclRecv(
                       recv_words + static_cast<std::uint64_t>(host_recv_offset[peer]) * words_per_item,
                       static_cast<std::size_t>(host_recv_count[peer]) * words_per_item,
                       ncclUint64,
                       static_cast<int>(peer),
                       comm,
                       stream),
                   "ncclRecv generic payload");
    }
    check_nccl(ncclGroupEnd(), "ncclGroupEnd generic payload exchange");

    const std::uint32_t self_count = host_send_count[local_rank];
    const std::uint64_t self_words = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(self_count) * words_per_item;
    const std::uint32_t block = 128;
    const std::uint32_t grid = static_cast<std::uint32_t>((self_words + block - 1ULL) / block);
    if (grid != 0) {
        stream5_self_copy_words_kernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(
            send_words,
            recv_words,
            host_send_offset[local_rank],
            host_recv_offset[local_rank],
            self_count,
            words_per_item);
    }
}

__global__ void final_scan_block_counts_phase_kernel(
    const std::uint32_t* block_counts,
    std::uint32_t* block_offsets,
    const std::uint32_t* output_base,
    std::uint32_t* final_candidate_count,
    std::uint32_t block_count,
    std::uint64_t phase_global_prefix,
    std::uint64_t global_keep_count) {
    if (blockIdx.x != 0 || threadIdx.x != 0) {
        return;
    }
    std::uint32_t running = 0;
    for (std::uint32_t block = 0; block < block_count; ++block) {
        block_offsets[block] = running;
        running += block_counts[block];
    }
    const std::uint32_t base = final_phase_base_device(output_base);
    if (global_keep_count == 0ULL || phase_global_prefix >= global_keep_count) {
        *final_candidate_count = base;
        return;
    }
    const std::uint64_t remaining_global_keep = global_keep_count - phase_global_prefix;
    const std::uint64_t capped =
        static_cast<std::uint64_t>(running) < remaining_global_keep
            ? static_cast<std::uint64_t>(running)
            : remaining_global_keep;
    *final_candidate_count = base + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(capped);
}

__global__ void final_save_count_kernel(
    const std::uint32_t* final_candidate_count,
    std::uint32_t* saved_count) {
    if (blockIdx.x == 0 && threadIdx.x == 0) {
        *saved_count = *final_candidate_count;
    }
}

__global__ void final_scatter_exact_phase_kernel(
    const CandidateMeta* survivor_shard,
    const std::uint32_t* keep_flags,
    const std::uint32_t* block_offsets,
    const std::uint32_t* output_base,
    CandidateMeta* final_candidate_buffer,
    const std::uint32_t* final_candidate_count,
    std::uint64_t phase_global_prefix,
    std::uint64_t global_keep_count,
    std::uint32_t final_capacity,
    std::uint32_t shard_count,
    std::uint32_t shard_capacity_candidates) {
    __shared__ std::uint32_t scan[256];
    const std::uint32_t tid = threadIdx.x;
    const std::uint64_t shard_capacity = shard_capacity_candidates;
    const std::uint64_t total = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(shard_count) * shard_capacity;
    const std::uint64_t i = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + tid;
    const std::uint32_t keep = i < total ? keep_flags[i] : 0U;
    scan[tid] = keep;
    __syncthreads();
    for (std::uint32_t offset = 1U; offset < blockDim.x; offset <<= 1U) {
        const std::uint32_t add = tid >= offset ? scan[tid - offset] : 0U;
        __syncthreads();
        scan[tid] += add;
        __syncthreads();
    }
    if (keep == 0U || *final_candidate_count > final_capacity || global_keep_count == 0ULL) {
        return;
    }
    const std::uint32_t base = final_phase_base_device(output_base);
    const std::uint32_t phase_local = block_offsets[blockIdx.x] + scan[tid] - 1U;
    const std::uint32_t local_out = base + phase_local;
    if (local_out >= *final_candidate_count) {
        return;
    }
    const std::uint64_t global_idx = phase_global_prefix + phase_local;
    if (global_idx >= global_keep_count) {
        return;
    }
    final_candidate_buffer[local_out] = survivor_shard[i];
}

void instantiate_captured_graph(cudaStream_t stream, cudaGraph_t& graph, cudaGraphExec_t& exec) {
    check_cuda(cudaStreamEndCapture(stream, &graph), "cudaStreamEndCapture");
    check_cuda(cudaGraphInstantiate(&exec, graph, nullptr, nullptr, 0), "cudaGraphInstantiate");
}

void ensure_stream4_slot_resources(DispatcherStreams& streams, std::uint32_t slot_count) {
    if (streams.stream4_slot_streams.size() == slot_count && streams.stream4_slot_done.size() == slot_count) {
        return;
    }
    for (cudaStream_t stream : streams.stream4_slot_streams) {
        if (stream) {
            cudaStreamDestroy(stream);
        }
    }
    for (cudaEvent_t event : streams.stream4_slot_done) {
        if (event) {
            cudaEventDestroy(event);
        }
    }
    streams.stream4_slot_streams.assign(slot_count, nullptr);
    streams.stream4_slot_done.assign(slot_count, nullptr);
    for (std::uint32_t slot = 0; slot < slot_count; ++slot) {
        check_cuda(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&streams.stream4_slot_streams[slot], cudaStreamNonBlocking), "cudaStreamCreate stream4 slot");
        check_cuda(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&streams.stream4_slot_done[slot], cudaEventDisableTiming), "cudaEventCreate stream4 slot done");
    }
}

void update_threshold_global(
    const StaticMemoryPlan& plan,
    StaticDeviceMemory& memory,
    cudaStream_t stream,
    bool periodic,
    const DispatcherCollective* collective) {
    const std::uint64_t threshold_width = plan.derived.global_beam_width_effective;
    threshold_build_local_histogram_cuda(
        memory.streams.shard_score_hist_a,
        memory.streams.shard_score_hist_b,
        memory.streams.shard_score_hist_active_index,
        memory.streams.threshold_hist_active_snapshot,
        memory.streams.local_score_hist,
        plan.storage_shard_count,
        stream);
    if (plan.config.world_size == 1U) {
        check_cuda(cudaMemcpyAsync(
            memory.streams.global_score_hist,
            memory.streams.local_score_hist,
            SCORE_BIN_COUNT * sizeof(std::uint64_t),
            cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice,
            stream), "cudaMemcpyAsync single gpu histogram");
    } else {
        if (collective == nullptr || collective->comm == nullptr) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("multi rank threshold update requires NCCL collective");
        }
        threshold_allreduce_histogram_nccl_cuda(
            memory.streams.local_score_hist,
            memory.streams.global_score_hist,
            collective->comm,
            stream);
    }
    if (periodic) {
        threshold_update_periodic_cuda(
            memory.streams.global_score_hist,
            memory.streams.current_threshold,
            memory.streams.threshold_initialized,
            threshold_width,
            stream);
    } else {
        threshold_select_cuda(
            memory.streams.global_score_hist,
            memory.streams.current_threshold,
            threshold_width,
            stream);
    }
}

} // namespace

void create_dispatcher_streams(DispatcherStreams& streams) {
    NvtxRange range("Dispatcher_create_streams");
    check_cuda(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&streams.stream1, cudaStreamNonBlocking), "cudaStreamCreate stream1");
    check_cuda(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&streams.stream2, cudaStreamNonBlocking), "cudaStreamCreate stream2");
    check_cuda(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&streams.stream3, cudaStreamNonBlocking), "cudaStreamCreate stream3");
    check_cuda(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&streams.stream4, cudaStreamNonBlocking), "cudaStreamCreate stream4");
    check_cuda(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&streams.stream5, cudaStreamNonBlocking), "cudaStreamCreate stream5");
}

void destroy_dispatcher_streams(DispatcherStreams& streams) {
    if (streams.stream1) {
        cudaStreamDestroy(streams.stream1);
    }
    if (streams.stream2) {
        cudaStreamDestroy(streams.stream2);
    }
    if (streams.stream3) {
        cudaStreamDestroy(streams.stream3);
    }
    if (streams.stream4) {
        cudaStreamDestroy(streams.stream4);
    }
    if (streams.stream5) {
        cudaStreamDestroy(streams.stream5);
    }
    for (cudaStream_t stream : streams.stream4_slot_streams) {
        if (stream) {
            cudaStreamDestroy(stream);
        }
    }
    for (cudaEvent_t event : streams.stream4_slot_done) {
        if (event) {
            cudaEventDestroy(event);
        }
    }
    streams = DispatcherStreams{};

# Project Agent Rules

## Operating Rule
- Read `AGENTS.md` before project edits.
- Update `memory/CHANGELOG.md` after meaningful code, config, or architecture changes.
- Update `memory/PROMPTS.md` with user prompts that define requirements.
- Store test outputs, logs, and verification notes under `test_results/`.
- Prefer agent-centered code: explicit contracts, deterministic tests, small files, low hidden state.

## Architecture Source
- Primary architecture contract: `ARCHITECTURE_NEED.md`.
- Current Stream 4 implementation rule: use threshold + compact + CUB/fixed-temp sort/reduce + compact; do not use Stream 4 hash-table dedup.

## Implementation Guardrails
- `State128` logical bytes are `v[0..119]`.
- `State128` padding bytes are `v[120..127]`.
- Persistent frontier padding must be zero.
- `FinalResponse` may temporarily store `target_local_idx` in `v[120..123]`.
- `Hash128` is one logical 128-bit key stored as `{lo, hi}`.
- `CandidateMeta` must remain 32 bytes and 32-byte aligned.
- Stream 3 payload id must be original candidate id, not compact index.
- Stream 4 must not apply shard top-k or semantic shard cap.

  455: global_score_hist[SCORE_BIN_COUNT] : uint64_t
  456: 
  457: current_threshold : uint32_t
  458: ```
  459: 
  460: ## scratch_pool: three overlay layouts
  461: 
  462: ```text
  463: layout_1_streams:
  464:     Stream 1/2 score/hash/parent rings
  465:     Stream 3 threshold/compact/sort/dedup/split scratch
  466:     Stream 5 CandidateMeta send/recv slots
  467:     Stream 4 survivor_shard/dirty/clean/sort scratch
  468: 
  469: layout_2_final_select:
  470:     final local dedup/filter/threshold/load-balance scratch
  471:     final_candidate_buffer : CandidateMeta[N_LOCAL]
  472:     final_selected_buffer  : CandidateMeta[(N_LOCAL * sizeof(State128)) / sizeof(CandidateMeta)] when WORLD_SIZE > 1
  473: 
  474: layout_3_final_materialize:
  475:     ring_slots = 3
  476:     chunk_capacity = min(N_LOCAL, STREAM3_BATCH_CANDIDATES)
  477:     exchange_capacity = chunk_capacity * WORLD_SIZE
  478:     key_slot_a[ring_slots][exchange_capacity] : uint32_t
  479:     key_slot_b[ring_slots][exchange_capacity] : uint32_t
  480:     request_slot_a[ring_slots][exchange_capacity] : FinalRequest
  481:     request_slot_b[ring_slots][exchange_capacity] : FinalRequest
  482:     request_recv_slot[ring_slots][exchange_capacity] : FinalRequest
  483:     response_send_slot[ring_slots][exchange_capacity] : FinalResponse
  484:     response_recv_slot[ring_slots][exchange_capacity] : FinalResponse
  485:     history_send_slot[ring_slots][chunk_capacity] : FinalHistoryRecord
  486:     history_recv_slot[ring_slots][exchange_capacity] : FinalHistoryRecord
  487:     fixed CUB temp for request sort by rank key
  488: ```
  489: 
  490: ## scratch_pool: layout_final
  491: 
  492: ```text
  493: next_frontier_states_tmp[N] : State128
  494: 
  495: final_request_buffer
  496: final_validation_error : FinalRequestValidationError
  497: final_response_buffer : FinalResponse / State128
  498: 
  499: final_send_count[WORLD_SIZE]      : uint32_t
  500: final_send_offset[WORLD_SIZE + 1] : uint32_t
  501: 
  502: final_recv_count[WORLD_SIZE]      : uint32_t
  503: final_recv_offset[WORLD_SIZE + 1] : uint32_t
  504: ```
  505: 
  506: Final materialization data-plane:
  507: 
  508: ```text
  509: CPU participates only in CandidateMeta history transfer after GPU materialization chunk ownership is fixed.
  510: CPU does not participate in FinalRequest exchange.
  511: CPU does not participate in FinalResponse exchange.
  512: GPU builds FinalRequest directly from selected CandidateMeta chunks.
  513: GPU exchanges FinalRequest / FinalResponse through NCCL only.
  514: source_rank == local_rank request path is local GPU work, not NCCL traffic.
  515: return_rank == local_rank response path writes next_frontier_states_tmp directly, not NCCL traffic.
  516: remote response slots are pre-partitioned by return_rank offsets; no atomic write is required.
  517: request slots are sorted/grouped by source_rank before NCCL exchange.
  518: response work slots are sorted/grouped by return_rank before NCCL exchange.
  519: ```
  520: 
  521: Layout 3 chunk lifetime:
  522: 
  523: ```text
  524: candidate_meta_chunk -> build request/history records on GPU
  525: candidate_meta_chunk -> async CPU history copy may run independently from GPU-GPU materialization
  526: after request/history build and CPU history transfer for the chunk are queued, candidate_meta_chunk memory may be reused
  527: ```

- Raised score quantization precision by changing `SCORE_SCALE` from `128` to `1024`; `CandidateMeta` and score key type remain unchanged, while score histogram bin count increases.
- Reworked production CPU history storage from full `CandidateMeta` records to compressed `HistoryEntry{parent_idx, route_packed}` records. RAM and disk history now store 16 bytes per candidate instead of 32 bytes per candidate.
- Added asynchronous RAM-history dead-branch pruning. After depth `d+1` is materialized on CPU, a background history worker compacts depth `d` to parent indices referenced by depth `d+1` and remaps `depth d+1` parent indices. `BEAM_HISTORY_WORKERS` controls concurrent pruning workers.
- Added Kaggle notebook config `HISTORY_WORKERS` and passes it to `BEAM_HISTORY_WORKERS`.
- Added optional known-solution survival tracing to `production_runner`. When `BEAM_TRACK_SOLUTION_PATH` is set, the runner hashes each expected prefix state and scans final per-depth `CandidateMeta` hashes to log whether the prefix survived the final threshold/cap. `BEAM_STOP_AFTER_TRACKED_PATH=1` stops a diagnostic run after the tracked path length when the solution was not found.
- Changed Kaggle notebook to pass known solution paths for puzzles 1 through 20, print `track_solution_*` lines, set `DEPTH_LIMIT=32` for survival diagnostics, and pass `BEAM_STOP_AFTER_TRACKED_PATH`.
- Fixed a `SCORE_SCALE=1024` threshold bug in Stream4 score histograms: score-key histogram radix sort now uses 32 score bits instead of 16, matching `SCORE_MAX_KEY=307200`. The old 16-bit sort split high score keys into non-contiguous groups and undercounted histogram bins, which allowed `final_threshold=UINT32_MAX` even when clean survivors exceeded the aligned beam.
- Changed final filter/load-balance selection to score-prioritized exact beam cutting: candidates with `score_key < final_threshold` are emitted first, then only the remaining aligned beam slots are filled with `score_key == final_threshold` candidates. Added a CUDA threshold test that would fail if layout-order capping drops a lower-score candidate.
- Added full tracked-solution path diagnostics. `production_runner` now logs `track_solution_prefinal` before final filtering and expanded `track_solution_prefix` after final filtering with matches, first/best index, score, threshold pass/margin, parent index, route fields, move name, and shard/local location where available.
- Added generated-candidate diagnostics before Stream3 thresholding. `run_depth_cuda_graphs` can now receive a tracked `(parent_idx, move)` request and logs `track_solution_generated` from score/hash rings after Stream1/2 finish and before Stream3 consumes the ring. This identifies whether a known path is lost in Stream1/2 generation, Stream3 threshold/dedup/collector, Stream4 threshold/dedup, or final filtering.
- Added Stream4 tracked-hash diagnostics. `production_runner` now logs `track_solution_stream4` with the tracked hash location after Stream3 collector (`clean`, `dirty`, `active_spill`, `inactive_spill`), Stream4 input threshold/pass state for the target shard job, and Stream4 output survival in the clean region.
- Added detailed tracked-parent Stream1 score diagnostics. For the tracked parent, `production_runner` now logs all 24 CUDA move scores/ranks and a host reference-forward score/rank table from the same exported fp16 weights and copied parent state. Added all-Stream4-event trace lines for the tracked shard and `BEAM_STOP_AFTER_TRACKED_MISSING_EXTRA_DEPTHS` to stop two depths after the first missing tracked prefix. # Final Materialize Overlap And Memory Reduction 2026-05-26

## Scope
- Preserve `WORLD_SIZE=1` single-GPU final path.
- Reduce multi-rank layout-3 static memory by removing full-size multi-rank request/response buffers.
- Add static slot events for chunked multi-rank final materialization.

## Implementation Notes
- `final_request_buffer[N_LOCAL]` is allocated only when `WORLD_SIZE == 1`.
- `final_response_buffer` is not allocated for multi-rank final materialization.
- `final_selected_buffer` capacity is `min(GLOBAL_BEAM_WIDTH_EFFECTIVE, survivor_count)`.
- Multi-rank layout-3 uses three slots for keys, request ping-pong, request receive, response send/receive, history send/receive, and fixed CUB temp.
- Slot events: `build_done`, `history_done`, `request_done`, `response_ready`, `response_done`.

## Verification
- Status: pending after code edit.

*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: memory/CHANGELOG.md
@@
 - Added layout-3 slot events for multi-rank final materialization: `build_done`, `history_done`, `request_done`, `response_ready`, and `response_done`. Final request/history/response exchanges now record payload completion events, and response receive scatter is deferred until slot drain so response NCCL transfer can overlap later chunk work.
+- Kept the final exchange receive-offset host-to-device copy synchronous before payload enqueue so async payload execution never references stack-backed receive offset arrays after the exchange helper returns.
 - Updated `static_memory_cuda_tests` expectations for the reduced multi-rank layout: full request/response buffers must be absent in multi-rank final materialization, while 3-slot request/response/history buffers and fixed CUB temp remain statically allocated and aligned.
*** End Patch

```

# Project Agent Rules

## Operating Rule
- Read `AGENTS.md` before project edits.
- Update `memory/CHANGELOG.md` after meaningful code, config, or architecture changes.
- Update `memory/PROMPTS.md` with user prompts that define requirements.
- Store test outputs, logs, and verification notes under `test_results/`.
- Prefer agent-centered code: explicit contracts, deterministic tests, small files, low hidden state.

## Architecture Source
- Primary architecture contract: `ARCHITECTURE_NEED.md`.
- Current Stream 4 implementation rule: use threshold + compact + CUB/fixed-temp sort/reduce + compact; do not use Stream 4 hash-table dedup.

## Implementation Guardrails
- `State128` logical bytes are `v[0..119]`.
- `State128` padding bytes are `v[120..127]`.
- Persistent frontier padding must be zero.
- `FinalResponse` may temporarily store `target_local_idx` in `v[120..123]`.
- `Hash128` is one logical 128-bit key stored as `{lo, hi}`.
- `CandidateMeta` must remain 32 bytes and 32-byte aligned.
- Stream 3 payload id must be original candidate id, not compact index.
- Stream 4 must not apply shard top-k or semantic shard cap.

def stream_rank_log(rank: int, proc, log_path: Path):

            log.flush()
            if live_log_enabled(rank):

*** Begin Patch

@@
 - Reduced multi-rank final materialization static memory: full `final_request_buffer[N_LOCAL]` is now allocated only for `WORLD_SIZE=1`, full `final_response_buffer` is omitted for `WORLD_SIZE>1`, and the multi-rank selected-candidate buffer is capped at `min(GLOBAL_BEAM_WIDTH_EFFECTIVE, survivor_count)` instead of using the whole `State128` frontier byte area.
 - Added layout-3 slot events for multi-rank final materialization: `build_done`, `history_done`, `request_done`, `response_ready`, and `response_done`. Final request/history/response exchanges now record payload completion events, and response receive scatter is deferred until slot drain so response NCCL transfer can overlap later chunk work.
 - Kept the final exchange receive-offset host-to-device copy synchronous before payload enqueue so async payload execution never references stack-backed receive offset arrays after the exchange helper returns.
 - Updated `static_memory_cuda_tests` expectations for the reduced multi-rank layout: full request/response buffers must be absent in multi-rank final materialization, while 3-slot request/response/history buffers and fixed CUB temp remain statically allocated and aligned.
+- Prepared the Kaggle T4x2 validation path to use GitHub `main` as the source of truth rather than a source-archive dataset. The notebook diagnostic depth is set to 8 for a short multi-rank final-materialization test.
*** End Patch

```

index 4605f96..7a9b269 100644
--- a/memory/CHANGELOG.md
+++ b/memory/CHANGELOG.md
@@ -319,3 +319,15 @@
 - Fixed the final exchange offset lifetime bug by adding immutable host-side `FinalExchangePlan{count, offset, total}` objects per exchange phase. `history`, `request`, and `response` now keep independent send plans, and `exchange_u64_items` builds a local receive plan per call instead of reusing caller scratch offsets.
 - Tightened final exchange alignment: `FinalHistoryRecord` is now `alignas(32)` and exactly 64 bytes, `next_frontier_states_tmp` and `final_response_buffer` are allocated with at least `CandidateMeta` alignment because multi-rank final overlays them with `CandidateMeta`/`FinalHistoryRecord`, and final count/offset device service buffers are 256-byte aligned.
 - Local verification after the offset-plan/alignment fix: Docker build target `production_runner` passed, targeted CUDA tests passed 5/5, and `WORLD_SIZE=1` smoke `production_runner 0 1 4194304` passed.
+- Documented the three scratch-pool overlay layouts: Stream inference layout, final select/dedup layout, and final materialization layout. Layout 3 owns the static 3-slot ring for chunked GPU-GPU materialization and defines the final scratch sizing floor.
+- Reworked multi-rank final materialization to chunk selected `CandidateMeta` on GPU. Requests are built from selected chunks on GPU, grouped by `source_rank`, exchanged through NCCL without CPU payload staging, materialized by source rank, regrouped by `return_rank`, and scattered into the local `next_frontier_states_tmp`. Self-source and self-return paths stay local and skip NCCL payload traffic.
+- Added static layout-3 buffers: selected candidate storage, rank key ping-pong arrays, request ping-pong arrays, request receive arrays, response send/receive arrays, history send/receive arrays, and fixed CUB temp. `FinalHistoryRecord` is now a shared 64-byte/32-aligned project type.
+- Replaced final exchange host control vectors in the new multi-rank final materialization path with fixed-size static arrays (`kFinalExchangeMaxWorldSize=128`) so per-chunk final request/response planning does not allocate dynamic host containers.
+- Moved debug final request validation error storage from `cudaMalloc` to a static `layout_final` slot (`FinalRequestValidationError`, 48 bytes, 16-byte aligned), removing the last CUDA dynamic allocation inside final materialization code.
+- Extended `static_memory_cuda_tests` with multi-rank layout-3 capacity/alignment assertions for 3 slots, exchange capacity, selected-buffer sizing, request/response/history slot pointers, and 256-byte CUB temp alignment.
+- Local verification after layout-3 materialization changes: Docker full build passed, targeted CUDA tests passed 4/4 (`final_cuda_tests`, `threshold_cuda_tests`, `dispatcher_cuda_tests`, `static_memory_cuda_tests`), and a manual small-config `WORLD_SIZE=1` `production_runner 0 1 4096` smoke passed. Local default auto-config smoke still fails on the RTX 3070 Laptop GPU budget, so real multi-rank runtime validation remains pending on Kaggle T4x2. Report saved as `test_results/final_materialize_layout3_2026-05-26.md`.
+- Reduced multi-rank final materialization static memory: full `final_request_buffer[N_LOCAL]` is now allocated only for `WORLD_SIZE=1`, full `final_response_buffer` is omitted for `WORLD_SIZE>1`, and the multi-rank selected-candidate buffer is capped at `min(GLOBAL_BEAM_WIDTH_EFFECTIVE, survivor_count)` instead of using the whole `State128` frontier byte area.
+- Added layout-3 slot events for multi-rank final materialization: `build_done`, `history_done`, `request_done`, `response_ready`, and `response_done`. Final request/history/response exchanges now record payload completion events, and response receive scatter is deferred until slot drain so response NCCL transfer can overlap later chunk work.
+- Kept the final exchange receive-offset host-to-device copy synchronous before payload enqueue so async payload execution never references stack-backed receive offset arrays after the exchange helper returns.
+- Updated `static_memory_cuda_tests` expectations for the reduced multi-rank layout: full request/response buffers must be absent in multi-rank final materialization, while 3-slot request/response/history buffers and fixed CUB temp remain statically allocated and aligned.
+- Prepared the Kaggle T4x2 validation path to use GitHub `main` as the source of truth rather than a source-archive dataset. The notebook diagnostic depth is set to 8 for a short multi-rank final-materialization test.
diff --git a/memory/PROMPTS.md b/memory/PROMPTS.md

 - User approved adding detailed final-exchange logging like other stream diagnostics and requested a compile/config flag so production runs do not compile or pay for the diagnostic code.
 - User required no unapproved algorithmic changes while diagnosing the final exchange failure; current approved scope is detailed logging, full-debug Kaggle run, and investigation from produced logs.
 - User approved the final exchange fix after reviewing the offset corruption: final exchange phases must have independent buffer layout plans, `FinalHistoryRecord` must be `align=32` and size multiple of `32/64`, and alignment must be respected for service buffers and any `ExchangePlan`-style helper.
+- User required the final architecture to use three logical layouts over one scratch pool: layout 1 for Stream 1/2/3/4/5 inference, layout 2 for final dedup/threshold/selection, and layout 3 for next-frontier materialization.
+- User required layout 3 to be a static chunked materialization layout with a 3-slot ring, events/streams conceptually separating materialization, transfers, and final writes, and alignment respected for every request/response/history buffer.
+- User clarified CPU responsibilities in finalization: CPU receives only `CandidateMeta` for RAM history; CPU must not participate in GPU-GPU `FinalRequest`/`FinalResponse` communication.
+- User required final materialization to reuse selected `CandidateMeta` chunks after request/history extraction, with GPU requests sent to source ranks, source ranks materializing responses, self-source/self-return paths staying local, and response slots pre-partitioned by `return_rank` to avoid atomic writes.
+- User required no dynamic allocation in the final materialization path; static arrays, pointers, service buffers, and precomputed offsets are the required implementation style.
+- User required implementing the layout-3 final materialization scheme while preserving `WORLD_SIZE=1` behavior exactly and reducing static allocation by relying on freed `CandidateMeta` chunks where possible.
